about: Where the page may go, what opens outside the app, and which of the page's requests are the daemon's media (desktop/electron/main.ts for the desktop page). rule is one of: outside (the address opens in the system's browser: expect true or false), stays (the address is the page's own origin, Android https://localhost, iOS capacitor://localhost: expect true or false), media (the address is a request for the daemon's media, under Android https://localhost/_pine_media, iOS pine-media://daemon: expect {path, search} with search "?..." or "", or null).
